title: Shine On, Harvest Moon
commons_title: File:Ada Jones and Billy Murray - Shine On, Harvest Moon.ogg
composition: words by Jack Norworth, music by Nora Bayes (1908); both public domain
credit: Performed by Ada Jones and Billy Murray; this recording is public domain on Wikimedia Commons.
lyrics: Shine on, shine on harvest moon
I ain't had no lovin' since January, February, June or July
Snow time ain't no time to stay outdoors and spoon
So shine on, shine on harvest moon, for me and my gal
